about: Chat 9 round K1 (inbox, chat 8 / Brandon Oct 28 7 AM: 'why no map for Green River State Natural Area'): which LIVE Kentucky layers hold Boiling Springs (OKNP point 37.30642,-85.719109) and Brandon's boundary-sign point 37.2948,-85.832497 (Timberlake? 115.75 ac)? Point queries (within 800 m) on every polygon layer of the KY nature-preserve / natural-area / state-land services, + a walk of kygisserver for any other OKNP layer, + KyGeoportal search. Plus Slovenia ARSO WFS typenames. Results: roundK1-tested.json.
